changelog.body:
Verified against Virtual Desktop 1.34.25.

- Interface translation now covers 23 languages: added Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Catalan and Romanian. These were made with translation software, so corrections are welcome.
- Background music can now play Nightride FM or Rainwave as well as Nightwave Plaza, each with a choice of stations.

Tested on a Quest 3 (arm64-v8a) and libxposed API 102.

Verified against Virtual Desktop 1.34.25.

- “Virtual Desktop Android” package name is now also supported.

Tested on a Quest 3 (arm64-v8a) and libxposed API 102.

First release in the module repo.

- Interface translation for Virtual Desktop's UI (French and Chinese so far)
- Extended bitrate range, and removal of VD's internal bitrate cap
- Custom background music, streaming Nightwave Plaza by default
- Mute for the performance cue sounds
- Force LAN discovery on networks where the remote server is unreachable
- A VDEXTRA page inside Virtual Desktop's own control panel for most settings

Tested on a Quest 3 (arm64-v8a) with Virtual Desktop 1.34.22 and libxposed API 102.

readme:
VDExtra

Xposed module to add extra features to **Virtual Desktop** (VR). > Does not circumvent the license requirement from the application. Please buy the software legitimately [here](https://www.vrdesktop.net/) ! ⚠️ EARLY STAGE ⚠️ This project is in its early stages. Currently tested only on my own personal hardware: - arm64-v8a (Quest 3) - libxposed API 102 - Virtual Desktop 1.34.22 and 1.34.25 **The module may misbehave by either not changing anything in **VD** (failed to hook internals of the app) or by crashing VD at launch (which in the Quest translate to a long load and then a dialog about the app not responding). If you meet these two situations then please [open an issue](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/issues) with your hardware specifications and the **VD** version that you are running.** ## Features - **Interface translation**: Translate **VD**'s UI in one of the currently supported languages. Do note that I am not polyglot, the current translations were made by using translation software. - Contributions to new languages are welcomed. Feel free to submit a merge request (see the [translation doc](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/blob/main/docs/translations.md)) - Resize of some elements for better fit in languages with more symbols. - **Extend bitrate range**: Increase the allowed maximum bitrate between **VD** and the connected machine. - ⚠️ Make sure to stay within your bandwidth, you will get choppy performance if you push this beyond your network capacity. - **Remove internal bitrate cap**: Prevent the measured bandwidth (internally from **VD**) from throttling what actually gets streamed. - ⚠️ Does not magically give you bandwidth. This is to prevent **VD** from meddling with the bitrate's current value when it does its own internal bandwidth check. - Generally you want this active if you use `Extend bitrate range`. - **Custom background music**: Changes the song and volume of the music playing when **VD** isn't connected to a machine. - 🐱🌙 Connects to [Nightwave Plaza](https://plaza.one/) by default. - For your own song, you need the file locally in the device. - **Disable performance cue sounds**: Mute the sounds that are played when you edit **VD**'s performance slider. - **Force LAN discovery**: Find local PCs even when the remote server is unreachable (fixes some restrictive networks). ## In Virtual Desktop Most of the module is configured from a **VDEXTRA** page in Virtual Desktop's own control panel. Its rows are clones of VD's own controls, so they match the rest of the interface, and they are translated along with everything else. A change takes effect straight away and survives a restart. ![The VDExtra page in Virtual Desktop's control panel, beside the companion app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/main/docs/vdextra-section.jpg) Settings that need Android to do the work stay in the companion app: the music source, the UI language, the update channel and which cue sounds to mute. ## Install 1. Install the module from your Xposed manager's repository list, or download `vdextra-.apk` from [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/releases). 2. Enable **VDExtra** in your Xposed manager; its static scope should default to Virtual Desktop. 1. Make sure the **Virtual Desktop** app is checked in the module's app scope. From **VD** 1.34.25 the app is listed as **Virtual Desktop Android**; older versions as **Virtual Desktop**. 3. Restart Virtual Desktop if it was running. This is required whenever you change the module's config. 1. Open the companion app to configure the module further than its default. ## Source Source, issues and the development history live in [git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra). ## License [MIT](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/blob/main/LICENSE).
readmeZh:
VDExtra

Xpose 模块为 **虚拟桌面** (VR) 添加额外功能。 > 不规避应用程序的许可要求。请在[此处](https://www.vrdesktop.net/)合法购买该软件！ ⚠️早期阶段⚠️ 该项目尚处于早期阶段。目前仅在我自己的个人硬件上进行了测试： -arm64-v8a（任务 3） -libxpose API 102 - 虚拟桌面 1.34.22 和 1.34.25 **该模块可能会因不更改 **VD** 中的任何内容（无法挂钩应用程序的内部结构）或在启动时崩溃 VD（这在 Quest 中转化为长时间加载，然后出现有关应用程序无响应的对话框）而出现异常行为。 如果您遇到这两种情况，请[打开一个问题](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/issues)，说明您的硬件规格和您正在运行的 **VD** 版本。** ## 特点 - **界面翻译**：将**VD**的UI翻译为当前支持的语言之一。请注意，我不会多语言，当前的翻译是使用翻译软件完成的。 - 欢迎对新语言做出贡献。请随意提交合并请求（请参阅[翻译文档](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/blob/main/docs/translations.md)） - 调整某些元素的大小，以更好地适应具有更多符号的语言。 - **扩展比特率范围**：增加**VD**和连接的机器之间允许的最大比特率。 - ⚠️ 确保保持在您的带宽范围内，如果超出您的网络容量，您将获得不稳定的性能。 - **删除内部比特率上限**：防止测量的带宽（来自 **VD** 内部）限制实际传输的内容。 - ⚠️ 不会神奇地为您提供带宽。这是为了防止 **VD** 在进行自己的内部带宽检查时干扰比特率的当前值。 - 通常，如果您使用“扩展比特率范围”，则需要激活此功能。 - **自定义背景音乐**：更改**VD**未连接到计算机时播放的歌曲和音乐音量。 - 🐱🌙 默认连接【Nightwave Plaza】(https://plaza.one/)。 - 对于您自己的歌曲，您需要设备本地的文件。 - **禁用性能提示声音**：编辑**VD**的性能滑块时播放的声音静音。 - **强制 LAN 发现**：即使无法访问远程服务器，也能找到本地 PC（修复了一些限制性网络）。 ## 在虚拟桌面中 大多数模块是通过虚拟桌面自己的控制面板中的 **VDEXTRA** 页面进行配置的。 它的行是 VD 自己的控件的克隆，因此它们与界面的其余部分相匹配，并且它们是 与其他所有内容一起翻译。更改会立即生效，并且在重新启动后仍然有效。 ![虚拟桌面控制面板中的 VDExtra 页面，位于配套应用程序旁边](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/main/docs/vdextra-section.jpg) 需要 Android 来完成工作的设置保留在配套应用程序中：音乐源、UI 语言、更新频道以及静音提示音。 ## 安装 1. 从 Xposed 管理器的存储库列表中安装模块，或从 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/releases) 下载 `vdextra-.apk`。 2. 在您的 Xpose 管理器中启用 **VDExtra**；其静态范围应默认为虚拟桌面。1. 确保在模块的应用程序范围中选中 **虚拟桌面** 应用程序。从 **VD** 1.34.25 开始，该应用程序被列为 **虚拟桌面 Android**；旧版本为**虚拟桌面**。 3. 如果虚拟桌面正在运行，请重新启动它。每当您更改模块的配置时都需要这样做。 1. 打开配套应用程序以比默认模块进一步配置模块。 ## 来源 来源、问题和发展历史都在 [git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra](https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra)。 ## 许可证 [麻省理工学院]（https://github.com/git-morin/io.github.git_morin.vdextra/blob/main/LICENSE）。
